about: Street views that always ship (the user, 2026-09-30): famous stops in Azeroth. 'spot': a planned spot by id (rendered or not), kept by pack.ship_points and the harvester's ship.py on top of the 200 yd thinning, which they don't change. 'mark': still needs its exact standing point and facing, from the dev addon's /sv mark in game (sv.cmd landmarks merges them) or a hand estimate checked on a test render; 'near' is a map-data estimate of the place. A marked entry gets id, cont, x, y, z (the floor to stand on), facing, zone and mapID and status 'spot'.
